field_changes.old:
Changes
• You now have more options to export your data. In addition to having it sent via email, you can download the .csv directly, or copy it to the clipboard.
• Various smaller changes.

Bugfixes
• Fixed a bug where achievements were not displayed correctly for Norwegian users.
• Various minor bugfixes.

Questions about the update? Send us an email at info@alphaprogression.com

removed.text: RIR means "reps in reserve": how many more clean reps you think you could have completed.
Periodization lets training targets vary across several weeks.
Both are optional Pro features, along with deloads (easier phases of training).
